d: We are seeking an experienced and highly skilled Chief Tunnel Surveyor to lead all surveying activities across our microtunnelling and pipe jacking operations. Reporting to the Bahrain Operations Manager, you will play a critical role in ensuring tunnel alignment accuracy, operational compliance, and the successful delivery of complex infrastructure projects.

This is an excellent opportunity for a survey professional with extensive tunnelling experience who thrives in a technically challenging environment and enjoys leading teams, solving problems, and delivering results safely and accurately.
r: Lead and oversee all surveying activities associated with microtunnelling and pipe jacking projects.
Maintain tunnel alignment, line and level control within approved tolerances and project specifications.
Review and verify survey control data, centre line (CL), and invert levels (IL).
Manage the setup and operation of jacking frames, laser guidance systems, survey equipment, and monitoring systems.
Monitor tunnelling progress, alignment accuracy, and breakthrough readiness.
Conduct site inspections and provide technical support to operational teams.
Investigate and resolve alignment deviations and surveying challenges.
Review and approve daily survey reports and technical documentation.
Manage data logging systems and ensure survey records remain accurate and audit-ready.
Supervise and develop Surveyors, Assistant Surveyors, and other survey personnel.
Collaborate closely with Project Managers, Engineers, Contractors, and Clients.
Promote safe working practices and maintain the highest standards of health, safety, and operational compliance.
Extensive experience in Microtunnelling and Pipe Jacking Operations.
Significant surveying experience within construction, tunnelling, or major infrastructure projects.
Strong understanding of tunnel alignment, line and level control, and advanced surveying techniques.
Experience using Total Stations, laser guidance systems, survey instruments, and data logging technology.
Ability to interpret engineering drawings, specifications, and technical documentation.
Proven leadership and team management experience.
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and reporting skills.
Strong communication and stakeholder management abilities.
Experience working on major international infrastructure projects.
Ensuring survey documentation is accurate and audit-ready.
Managing survey equipment and monitoring systems effectively.
Leading survey teams to deliver project objectives safely and efficiently.
Providing timely and accurate operational reporting.
